rationale: All three lenses ran successfully. Two required-criteria fails (SR2, SR4) and two partials (AC1, AC3). Four blocking patch findings before approval. Critical: toggle-off is a no-op in saveChatHideToolOutputs — stale 'true' is never removed from localStorage, making the setting irrecoverable after page reload. Major: toggle is unreachable when tools=true but both modelSelector and skills are false (wrong outer gate in ChatConfiguration.tsx); SharedChatPage context omits hideToolOutputs, relying on undefined-is-falsy via an unsafe 'as' cast; useEffect restoration skips when history.length===0 on chat switch, causing missed restores on slow connections. Deferred 1: removeChatStorage missing hideToolOutputs key cleanup (sweepOrphanedChatKeys covers eventual cleanup; no immediate user-visible impact). Dismissed 1: blind-lens concern about other tool-output render sites — edge-case lens confirmed Thoughts[] are the correct and complete render target per spec. Commit format clean across all 5 commits.

business_review.evidence: Toggle exists and functions, but is unreachable when assistantFeatures.tools=true while both modelSelector and skills are false — the outer gate in ChatConfiguration.tsx line 54 short-circuits the entire General section.
ChatAiMessage.tsx hides the thoughts block when hideToolOutputs=true; the final <Markdown> response is unconditional. Confirmed by 5 unit tests.

Enabling (true) persists correctly. Disabling (false) is a no-op: saveChatHideToolOutputs returns early without calling removeItem, so the stale 'true' remains in localStorage and restores on the next reload. Additionally, the useEffect restoration is skipped when history.length===0 at the moment of chat switch.
Label 'Hide tool outputs' is clear and the Switch UI is standard. Toggle is inaccessible for tools-only assistants (same root cause as AC1).

useState<boolean>(false) initialises to false; loadChatHideToolOutputs returns false when key absent; saveChatHideToolOutputs is no-op on false so first-load is always unset. Existing sessions unaffected.

ChatConfigHideToolOutputs is inside a JSX fragment gated on '(assistantFeatures.modelSelector || assistantFeatures.skills)' at ChatConfiguration.tsx:54. The inner guard on line 60 correctly checks assistantFeatures.tools, but the outer gate prevents the entire General section from rendering when only tools is enabled.

SharedChatPage builds ChatContext with only {openConfigForm, isSharedPage: true} cast as ChatContextValue. hideToolOutputs is undefined at runtime; '!hideToolOutputs' evaluates correctly as !undefined===true, so thoughts show on the shared page. However, this relies on implicit JS coercion and the TypeScript 'as' cast bypasses compile-time safety for all other UseChatConfigReturn fields.

saveChatHideToolOutputs line 59: 'if (!value) return' leaves stale 'true' in localStorage. Sequence: enable (stores true) → disable (no-op) → reload → loadChatHideToolOutputs reads 'true' → toggle re-enables. Also: useEffect (useChatConfiguration.tsx:188) skips load when history.length===0 at effect-fire time, with history.length absent from the dependency array.
sweepOrphanedChatKeys updated with hideToolOutputsPrefix in both the existence sweep and the empty-value sweep; tests at chatStorageUtils.test.ts cover both sweep paths.

standards_review.notes: All 5 commits in range follow 'EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence' format. No violations.
Guide not checked in this pass. Pre-commit hooks (ESLint, tsc --noEmit, license-headers, secrets scan) passed on all commits, covering the primary automated quality gates.
No security-relevant changes; localStorage use is for a UI boolean preference with no auth, injection, or data-leak surface.

findings.problem: saveChatHideToolOutputs is a no-op when value===false but does not remove an existing 'true' entry from localStorage.
findings.impact: Once the user enables the toggle, disabling it has no persistent effect. After any page reload, loadChatHideToolOutputs reads the stale 'true' and the toggle re-enables itself. The setting becomes irrecoverable without manually clearing localStorage.
findings.recommendation: Replace the early return with localStorage.removeItem: `if (!value) { localStorage.removeItem(\`${userId}_${chatHideToolOutputsKey(chatId)}\`); return; }`. Add a round-trip test: save(true) then save(false) → key absent from localStorage.

findings.problem: ChatConfigHideToolOutputs is inside the JSX fragment gated on '(assistantFeatures.modelSelector || assistantFeatures.skills)'. When assistantFeatures.tools=true but both modelSelector and skills are false, the entire General section — including the toggle — never renders.
findings.impact: Users of assistants that expose tools-only capability cannot access the hide-tool-outputs toggle, silently defeating the feature for the most directly relevant assistants.
findings.recommendation: Expand the outer gate: '(assistantFeatures.modelSelector || assistantFeatures.skills || assistantFeatures.tools)' so the General section renders whenever any of the three features is active.

findings.problem: SharedChatPage builds the ChatContext value without hideToolOutputs and uses an 'as ChatContextValue' cast. hideToolOutputs is undefined at runtime; '!hideToolOutputs' works only because !undefined===true.
findings.impact: The TypeScript 'as' cast suppresses all compile-time errors for missing UseChatConfigReturn fields. Any future accessor using 'hideToolOutputs === false' or setHideToolOutputs() in shared-page context would produce wrong results or crash silently.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit 'hideToolOutputs: false' and 'setHideToolOutputs: () => {}' to the SharedChatPage context object, removing reliance on undefined-is-falsy and the need for the unsafe cast.

findings.problem: The useEffect restores hideToolOutputs from localStorage only when currentChat?.history.length is truthy, but history.length is not in the dependency array. If a chat is selected while its history is still loading, the effect fires once with length===0, skips the load, and never re-fires when history populates.
findings.impact: On slow connections or direct-URL navigation, a stored hideToolOutputs=true setting is silently ignored for the entire session. Tool outputs appear unexpectedly with no visible indication the setting was missed.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) add currentChat?.history.length to the useEffect dependency array, or (b) remove the history.length gate entirely — loadChatHideToolOutputs returns false for a missing key, which is the correct default for new/empty chats, making the gate unnecessary.
